channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, US, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residency - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Creative Residency at Bloedel Reserve: Class of 2027
    https://bloedelreserve.slideroom.com/#/login/program/88209
    Bloedel Reserve · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · USD 22 application fee. Furnished private house on the grounds with linens, stocked kitchen, wi-fi, laundry and use of a smart car; an electric piano is available. Domestic residents receive a USD 1,000 stipend. International residents receive no stipend and may instead submit up to USD 1,000 of expenses for reimbursement. Residents pay for their own meals and their own travel to Bainbridge Island. There is no dedicated studio; residents work in the house.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.description:
• Ucross General Residency (All Disciplines): Spring 2027
    https://www.ucrossfoundation.org/residency-program.html
    Ucross Foundation · deadline Closed 15 Jul 2026 · No charge for the residency; living accommodations, meals, and work space provided. USD 40 application fee.
  • Kaatsbaan Subsidized Residencies
    https://kaatsbaan.org/subsidized-residencies
    Kaatsbaan Cultural Park · deadline Rolling / undated · Generously subsidized residency; includes hotel-style on-campus rooms, locally sourced meals, and access to studios, a 160-seat black box theater, and a 153-acre Hudson Valley campus. No artist stipend.

item.description:
• Grand Canyon Conservancy Residency 2027 (Artist / Astronomer / Environmental Educator)
    https://www.grandcanyon.org/experience-grand-canyon/residency-program
